# Phase 2 dependencies for the ResNet50 baseline (Target A).
#
# IMPORTANT: on Google Colab, torch/torchvision come preinstalled and are
# matched to the runtime's CUDA. Do NOT force-reinstall torch unless you have
# a reason — it is slow and can break CUDA. Instead, RECORD the versions Colab
# gives you (the notebook writes `pip freeze` to env/env_snapshot.txt).
#
# What actually matters for reproducing the split and metrics:
#   - numpy/scikit-learn: split permutation + AUC/F1 computation
#   - torchvision: the ResNet50_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1 enum + its transforms
#
# The split uses numpy's LEGACY RandomState, whose permutation depends only on
# array length + seed (not numpy version), so numpy pinning is belt-and-braces.

# Pin these (lightweight, reproducibility-critical):
numpy>=1.26,<3
pandas>=2.0
scikit-learn>=1.3
pillow>=9.0
tqdm>=4.65
matplotlib>=3.7
pyyaml>=6.0

# Use Colab's preinstalled torch/torchvision. If running locally, install a
# matched pair for your CUDA, e.g.:
#   torch==2.3.1
#   torchvision==0.18.1
# (Any torchvision >=0.13 exposes the ResNet50_Weights enum the code requires.)
